title: Verify: Store changes after shutdown do not reach the scene unit tests
summary: Unit tests that the subscription is released on shutdown.
description: Add tests/bootSceneShutdownUnsubscribe.test.ts with the same mocks, asserting no scene calls after shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: After shutdown setFocusedObject does not call focus on objects.
State updates after shutdown do not call sync.
technical_constraints: All Phaser, content and engine dependencies mocked

steps.action: Reuse mocks from tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts. Test 'ignores store changes after shutdown': boot.create(), invoke the 'shutdown' callback, vi.clearAllMocks on fake, call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject('bookshelf'); assert fake.focus and fake.sync not called. Test 'focus reset does not trigger sync': spy on boot.onStateChange via vi.spyOn, invoke shutdown, assert the spy was not called after the shutdown callback returned.
